recipe.visualDefinition: A composite image featuring a high-contrast male portrait in the lower-left foreground, a white colonial-style church steeple rising on the right, and lush green deciduous trees framing the top and left against a clear blue sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Portrait scale dominates the lower-left quadrant
Vertical steeple provides a strong upward diagonal counter-balance
Text elements bridge the gap between the portrait and the architecture
Pastel blue of the suit harmonizes with the clear sky background
coreInvariants: Soft, directional lighting on the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Male figure in extreme close-up, cropped at the shoulders, positioned in the bottom-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white church steeple acting as a vertical pillar on the right side.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves upward through the title text, follows the steeple to the sky, and descends via the script lettering back to the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open blue sky in the upper-center provides breathing room for the secondary typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue and foliage green providing a naturalistic backdrop.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white of the church and shirt collar for high-key highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft pastel pink/lavender used for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky and trees contrasted with the pale, desaturated tones of the suit and architecture.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of heavy, high-contrast serifs and fluid, monolinear scripts.
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses thick vertical strokes and thin horizontal hairlines
Script text maintains a consistent 45-degree slant
Tight letter spacing for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Elongated descenders on script letters to create movement
Hooked terminals on the display serif

composition.relationshipToImage: Bridges the gap between steeple and portrait

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for authority paired with a delicate script for personal signature feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme contrast and bold presence of the display text.
Provides the mid-century monolinear script feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1960s style photograph of a young man with dark pompadour hair wearing a light blue suit in the bottom left. In the background, show a white colonial church steeple on the right, surrounded by green trees under a clear blue sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large title in a bold, high-contrast pink serif font at the top left. Add a secondary name in a white slanted script font in the center-right area, angled upwards.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait in the lower-left?
Is the steeple on the right?
Is the main title pink and high-contrast?
Is the secondary text a white script?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the celebrity

avoid: Overlapping text that obscures the face

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the steeple does not touch the top edge
Check that the script text is legible against the sky
Verify the lighting on the face matches the outdoor setting
Confirm the color palette remains within the pastel/natural range
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a large-scale foreground portrait with a vertically-oriented architectural background element, linked by a mix of bold serif and light script typography.
